audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the packet and with the already-corrected mirror: level 1 was Skill (packet: Darius), levels 4-5 Skill (packet: Renekton), first item and two items Renekton (packet: Darius both).
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Darius, Renekton, Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Darius, Darius]. The mirror audit proposed exactly that chart as one atomic group on Darius's side, and this page's own whys[0] ('Darius has no cooldown to manage at level 1... give nothing'), whys[5] and whys[6] already argue for it.
audit.corrected: phases[0], phases[3], phases[5] and phases[6] flipped with win[0], win[3], win[5] and win[6] as one atomic group, ratings set inverse to the mirror's, and the four phase whys rewritten so each states why that side owns the stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend is the tracked cooldown on every screen of this page and its duration appears nowhere.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — one of the longest non-ultimate cooldowns in the game, and the entire 'bait it then commit' plan lives or dies on knowing how long the window lasts. At rank 1 a baited pull hands you 26 seconds of lane.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and phases[3].why now carry the 26s rank-1 figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemisation recommended Plated Steelcaps and anti-heal without naming why either matters, and the Crippling Strike auto-reset tell was absent.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags three things. Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled on Hemorrhage stacks, so armour is not the answer at 5 stacks. Decimate heals him off the blade portion, so Grievous Wounds decides the extended trades. Crippling Strike is an auto-attack reset on a 5s cooldown — the wind-up, not a spell cast, is the cue to leave.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now states the true-damage problem with armour and names Decimate as the healing to cut; wants.foe[1] carries the auto-reset tell.

audit.why: The level-6 treatment is already right and is the best writing on the page: Dominus HP does not save you from a true-damage execute at 5 stacks, and the instruction is to burst him below execute range before stacks land or leave clean. Nothing to change.

edits.before: Fury autos bully the first waves. Identify how Darius contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Darius has no cooldown to manage at 1 — his outer-Q crescent out-ranges you, so farm at tip and give nothing.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Apprehend's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1: bait it with a short step-up, then run the full E-W-Q pattern in the window before it returns.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Apprehend's cooldown.
edits.after: Black Cleaver lands before your Eclipse pays — trade only while Apprehend is down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Darius carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Cleaver shred and the execute win any long side-lane duel. Darius carry threat 9/10 — group and play for picks instead.

edits.before: His all-in starts on the pull. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His all-in starts on the pull — 26s at rank 1. Only engage once it is down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Past two items his Cleaver shred beats your Q heal outright.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse  (burst + the early bully curve), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse, then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps — but his R is true damage, so armour will not save you at 5 stacks. Executioner's Calling early: Decimate heals him.

edits.before: Stand at max range to clip you with the outer edge of his Q crescent while you try to E in
edits.after: Open with a Crippling Strike auto-reset — the wind-up is your cue to leave, not the cast

notes: The mirror audit reported an unfixed structural problem that also affects this side: full.breakdown.wave and full.report[4].t on the Darius page carry PDF-scrape contamination (embedded headers, stray bullet glyphs, duplicated blocks). On THIS page those two fields are clean, so nothing was proposed for them — but if mirror-fix.js reconciles the two directions it may pull the contaminated string across. Worth checking after the applier runs. Chart ratings here are set inverse to the mirror's, so the two pages should agree rather than fight. Apprehend's 26s rank-1 cooldown was absent from a page whose entire plan is baiting it.
